WITH phase_stats AS (
    SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    INNER JOIN observatories AS o
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.lunarstage
), phase_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg
    FROM phase_stats
), above_mean AS (
    SELECT ps.avg_bandusage, ps.telescope_count, pm.mean_phase_avg
    FROM phase_stats AS ps
    CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS pm
    WHERE ps.avg_bandusage > pm.mean_phase_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage), SUM(telescope_count), AVG(avg_bandusage - mean_phase_avg)
FROM above_mean
